useGlobalPrettier.title: Use Global Prettier
useGlobalPrettier.description: Search global npm and Yarn installations when no project-local engine exists. Disabled by default so cold saves can use the bundled engine immediately.

requireProjectDependency.title: Require Project Dependency
requireProjectDependency.description: Only offer Prettier when the project declares it as a dependency.

requireConfig.title: Require Configuration
requireConfig.description: Only offer Prettier when a Prettier configuration file is found.

respectEslintignore.title: Respect .eslintignore
respectEslintignore.description: Skip files listed in .eslintignore when offering Prettier formatting.

ignoreNodeModules.title: Ignore node_modules
ignoreNodeModules.description: Skip dependencies inside node_modules when formatting.

excludeVcsIgnoredPaths.title: Exclude VCS ignored paths
excludeVcsIgnoredPaths.description: Skip files your VCS ignores when formatting a project. Turn this off to format ignored files such as build output or vendored code.

debug.title: Debug Mode
debug.description: Log Prettier detection and resolution info to developer console.
